home.heroTagline: Privacy-first blood donor & recipient connect platform.
home.heroProblem: Blood availability information in India is scattered across government portals, hospital lists and WhatsApp forwards. In emergencies, families waste precious time, donor phone numbers get exposed publicly, and fake "urgent blood" money scams are common.

items.title: Find Blood Banks
items.description: Search blood banks and donation camps near you, and jump straight to the official e-RaktKosh portal for real-time stock.

items.title: Post Urgent Request
items.description: Post a verified urgent blood request with hospital details. Requests auto-expire and never ask for money.

items.title: Become a Donor
items.description: Sign up as an opt-in donor. Your phone number is never shown publicly — contact happens only through masked, in-app chat.

howItWorks.title: How it works
steps: Donors opt in and set their availability — nothing is imported from anywhere else.
Someone in need posts a verified request with hospital name and city.
RaktSetu connects them through masked, in-app contact, only after the donor accepts.
Requests automatically expire after {{hours}} hours to keep information fresh and safe.

privacySection.title: Privacy comes first
privacySection.body: We never scrape or import donor data from social media, WhatsApp, or third-party lists. Every donor on RaktSetu opted in themselves, and can pause their availability at any time.

antiScam.title: Never pay for blood
antiScam.body: RaktSetu never asks for money to arrange blood. Anyone asking you to pay for blood or for a donor's contact details is attempting a scam — please report it.

contributeSection.title: Built by students, for everyone
contributeSection.body: RaktSetu is an open-source project welcoming contributors from every background — frontend, backend, UI/UX, docs, translation and testing.

about.title: About RaktSetu
about.mission: RaktSetu exists to make finding blood in an emergency faster and safer, without exposing anyone's personal information or opening the door to scams.
about.maintainerBody: RaktSetu is maintained by Sai (github.com/saisiddi) as part of Nexus Spring of Code, a 45-day student open-source program.
about.contributeBody: RaktSetu welcomes beginners from every domain — frontend, backend, UI/UX, docs, translation and testing. See CONTRIBUTING.md in the repository to get started.

privacy.title: Privacy Principles
privacy.intro: These principles are non-negotiable and guide every feature we build.

principles.title: Opt-in donors only
principles.body: We never scrape, import or display personal data from social media, WhatsApp, or third-party lists. Every donor chose to be here.

principles.title: No public phone numbers
principles.body: Donor phone numbers are never shown publicly. Contact happens via in-app chat or masked contact, only after the donor accepts.

principles.title: Verified, auto-expiring requests
principles.body: Requests require a hospital name and city, and automatically expire ({{hours}} hours by default). RaktSetu never asks for money, and shows an anti-scam notice on every request.

principles.title: Official stock data, not scraping
principles.body: For real-time blood bank stock, we link to the official e-RaktKosh portal rather than scraping it ourselves.

principles.title: Obviously fake demo data
principles.body: All sample data in this repository is clearly labelled "Demo" and uses obviously fake values, such as "Demo Donor 1" and phone "XXXXXXXXXX".

principles.title: Configurable donation gaps
principles.body: Donors can toggle their availability and are automatically paused after donating until the required gap between donations has passed. That gap is configurable, not hardcoded into the interface.
